title: Loader deploy key missing
message: the secret SR_DEPLOYKEY_MODLOADER is not set in the environment fork-push of msantoro12/starrupture-ci (or the caller does not pass it by name); the candidate map rows cannot be pushed to the loader fork. Setup: ci/MAP-MODE.md, step 26.
"The ubuntu-latest label will migrate to Ubuntu 26 beginning October 19, 2026. For more information, see https://github.com/actions/runner-images/issues/14748"
